Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll, msvcp140.dll)

These libraries are redistributable Microsoft files. StokesForge ships them,
unmodified, next to its executable so that the application starts on a clean
Windows machine. Their redistribution is governed by the Microsoft Visual
Studio redistribution terms ("Distributable Code"), published by Microsoft:

  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files
  https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/

Microsoft does not provide a separate license file with these DLLs. This
document serves as the notice; it does not replace Microsoft's terms.
